provenance.note: Serial run after representative matrix and local release gates; public collection timings include exact rerank and filter/planner. Individual cells reproduce with bench-post-hnsw --profile cell and matching flags.

interpretation: 18 completed serial cells after local release gates and representative matrix. Binary compiled at 37; 38 preserves CPU query arithmetic while naming its SIMD constants for shared GPU use. Three warmups and 64 measured distinct queries per filter mode; nearest-rank p50/p95. Build stages have one sample each. Public collection timings include validation/filter/planner/traversal/F32 rerank, exclude snapshot capture, diagnostic candidate extraction and Python/HTTP. Do not compare with the prevalidated snapshot CPU batch scope in the GPU report.
